QuestInfo.name: [Sleepywood] Balrog and the Seal
QuestInfo.0: Manji's apprentice, Mu Young, has a pensive look on his face. Shall we hear what he has to say?
QuestInfo.1: Mu Young says his master was right to worry. He says Balrog, who was sealed by Tristan a number of decades ago, is preparing to reemerge. He has asked you to form an #bExpeditionary Team#k to prevent Balrog from reviving.
QuestInfo.2: Mu Young says his master was right to worry. He says Balrog, who was sealed by Tristan a number of decades ago, is preparing to reemerge. He has asked you to form an Expeditionary Team to prevent Balrog from reviving.\r\nBut as you tried to prevent Balrog's revival, he disappeared into thin air, and you had to tell Mu Young.
QuestInfo.summary: Let's form an Expeditionary Team and go into the cave where Balrog is sealed. You will do what you can to prevent Balrog from reviving and report back to Mu Young.

0.0: You were sent by Chun Ji, the brother of my master... So I assume you are very skilled yourself. Can you help?

yes.0: I came here to investigate at the request of my master and discovered something amazing. Many decades ago, my master was able to seal Balrog in this area where Tristan the hero was buried. But I keep finding subtle signs of Balrog's impending revival.
yes.1: So I went deep into the dungeon to stop Balrog from reviving, but that place was filled with powerful energy. I mean, the force of Balrog was tremendously strong even though he hasn't even revived yet.
yes.2: I don't know if I'd be able to handle Balrog on my own, even if he hasn't awakened. #bCould you please form an Expeditionary Team to help me prevent Balrog's revival?

no.0: Please, think about it. I really need your help.

1.0:
Ah, you're back! What happened to Balrog?

#b#L0#Hmmm... I don't know. The dungeon began to shake and he disappeared into the air.#l
#k
1.1: I see... I wonder where Balrog disappeared to. Anyways, thank you for delaying his return.

mob.0: Balrog is sealed behind that door. I don't recommend going in alone. Talk to me and form a #bBalrog Expeditionary Team#k before you enter.
